thm-hyp(list-partial(
  LA.VectorSpace(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace),
  Type.annotation(@n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, Nat),
  Type.annotation(@alpha@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, Type.to(LA.Fin(n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)),
  Type.annotation(@beta@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)
), Logic.iff(LA.LinearlyIndependent(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, alpha@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), LA.UniqueRepresentation(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, alpha@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily)))

values.zh-CN: α 线性无关当且仅当每个可由 α 表示的向量具有唯一系数族。
values.en: α is independent iff every represented vector has a unique coefficient family.
